deployment_point: slurmdbd, which records jobs as they enter and leave the queue
assumes: Accounting records scheduler *state changes* — submissions, cancellations, resizes — and their charged allocation. Queries against the queue and the accounting database are not themselves accounted events, so an out-of-scope inspection leaves no accounting trace.
why_expected: This annotation and dlp_would_flag are the two that vary, and are where the observability finding lives. An A2 crossing is visible here; A1, A3, and A4 crossings are not.
